mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.cover, g.image1, g.image2, g.price, g.intro, g.stock, g.type_id, t.name as type_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN type t ON g.type_id = t.id ORDER BY g.id DESC

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.cover, g.image1, g.image2, g.price, g.intro, g.stock, g.type_id, t.name as type_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN type t ON g.type_id = t.id WHERE g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') ORDER BY g.id DESC
SELECT g.id, g.name, g.cover, g.image1, g.image2, g.price, g.intro, g.stock, g.type_id, t.name as type_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN type t ON g.type_id = t.id ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.cover, g.image1, g.image2, g.price, g.intro, g.stock, g.type_id, t.name as type_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN type t ON g.type_id = t.id WHERE g.type_id = #{typeId} ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.cover, g.image1, g.image2, g.price, g.intro, g.stock, g.type_id, t.name as type_name FROM goods g JOIN recommend r ON g.id = r.good_id LEFT JOIN type t ON g.type_id = t.id GROUP BY g.id ORDER BY MAX(r.id) DESC

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.cover, g.image1, g.image2, g.price, g.intro, g.stock, g.type_id, t.name as type_name FROM goods g JOIN recommend r ON g.id = r.good_id LEFT JOIN type t ON g.type_id = t.id WHERE r.type = #{type} GROUP BY g.id ORDER BY MAX(r.id) DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods(name, cover, image1, image2, price, intro, stock, type_id) VALUES(#{name}, #{cover}, #{image1}, #{image2}, #{price}, #{intro}, #{stock}, #{typeId})
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET name = #{name}, cover = #{cover}, image1 = #{image1}, image2 = #{image2}, price = #{price}, intro = #{intro}, stock = #{stock}, type_id = #{typeId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.cover, g.image1, g.image2, g.price, g.intro, g.stock, g.type_id, t.name as type_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN type t ON g.type_id = t.id WHERE g.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET stock = stock - #{amount} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{amount}
